description: Expected visual regions and thresholds for Notepad++ window analysis.

menu_bar.name: menu/top area
menu_bar.expected_content: File Edit Search View Encoding Language Settings Macro Run Plugins Window ?

statusbar.name: statusbar/bottom band
statusbar.expected_content: line count, encoding, file type, caret position

file_dialog_icon_zones.name: file dialog icon zones
file_dialog_icon_zones.note: Only present when dialog is open. Analyzed separately from main window.
file_dialog_icon_zones.expected_content: yellow folder icons, file type icons

windows_baseline.note: No Windows baseline artifact yet. UI metrics checks must stay yellow until baseline is captured.

known_visual_defects.name: TOOLBAR_BLACK_OR_LOW_COLOR
known_visual_defects.note: CG capture shows colored icons in some runs but helper capture shows black/gray. Needs CG ground truth validation.

known_visual_defects.name: STATUSBAR_BAD_BACKGROUND
known_visual_defects.note: Codex is actively fixing statusbar / bottom black band. Do not interfere.

known_visual_defects.name: SCROLLBAR_BLACK_ARTIFACT
known_visual_defects.note: Scrollbar thumb may render black. Needs zoomed CG capture evidence.

known_visual_defects.name: FILE_DIALOG_FOLDER_ICONS_BLACK
known_visual_defects.note: Open/Save dialog folder icons may render black. Needs dialog CG capture.

known_visual_defects.name: MENU_TOO_TALL
known_visual_defects.note: No Windows baseline yet. Cannot determine if menu is too tall.

forbidden_actions: Do NOT instrument comctl32/toolbar.c directly (causes c000007b regressions)
Do NOT patch engine/hyperbridge for visual defects
Do NOT launch Wine runs for visual lab work
Do NOT mark visual checks green without Windows baseline or CG ground truth
